prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce exactly ONE high-fidelity clear Simplified Chinese PUBLIC BLOG webpage design, straight-on complete page, no device/browser frame or developer captions. Image1 is the matching REAL pre-redesign public baseline and is content/role/template/selected-state authority; source render.ts and configured fields are functional authority. Image2 PILOT-WS-001 is ONLY shared restrained flat surfaces, readable typography/density, fine dividers, alignment and small radii reference. NO owner rail/avatar/private note tree/settings/actions and NO new DooKnow wordmark replacing the configured public brand.
Preserve dynamic configured blog brand EXACTLY “隔离示例手记”, subtitle “真实接口驱动的界面盘点样例。”, configured author “示例作者”, and configured saved accent #44684f (muted forest green). Do NOT override this saved green accent with generic blue. Use calm flat white/light gray surfaces, clear dark text and muted secondary text, thin quiet borders and restrained8px radii, no gradients/textures/heavy shadows. Preserve actual magazine/profile/article template distinctions and all configured module ordering; no homogenizing to note workspace.
Real public site header: configured brand/title+subtitle at left, horizontal nav at right exactly 首页, 文章, 专题, 归档, 关于, RSS. Select only actual current route. No logo icon added to configured text brand, no hamburger/owner controls, no admin/edit/upload/publish/login button. Footer source: left linked brand 隔离示例手记 and muted author 示例作者; right 订阅 RSS. Social links absent, so none invented.
Render exactly the baseline visible content and source-existing conditional controls. One coherent state; no all-state composition. No teams/members, AI chat, ToDoo content, protocol fields requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF, fake online/connected/success business results. All content is declared isolated fixture; no private paths or real credentials. Keep native readable Chinese, large content may use longer canvas instead of text shrinking.
SELECTED PAGE:
PROFILE TEMPLATE HOME. Target approximately1536×2048 complete long page at natural desktop density, central content around1040px. 首页 active. Preserve distinctive PROFILE layout, NO magazine display masthead. Below public header use left approximately240px profile identity sidebar and right wide content column with about56px gap. Left sticky-style source section 关于我, eyebrow 记录、连接与行动, large name 示例作者, link 浏览文章 →. NO avatar, banner, bio or social icons because fixture fields are empty.
Right column source modules in exact actual order. 精选文章 section: lightly tinted flat pale-green container with TWO stacked source fixture articles separated by fine line. Each has 置顶, 2026-11-04 · 方法, exact title 让知识保持可用, summary 用于页面盘点的隔离发布快照。. No cover because absent. 最近更新 section below: the same TWO published fixture entries as a vertical profile stream, source metadata/title/summary, not magazine card grid; action 查看全部文章 → at end.
Continue actual enabled lower modules from source below original captured viewport: 专题合集 with one source card 专题 · 1 篇, title 记录的方法, description 隔离盘点示例合集; 我的项目 empty 暂无项目。; 友情链接 empty 暂无友情链接。. Keep these in right content column with left identity remaining only one profile block; no new duplicates/extra content. Footer spans normal site width with linked 隔离示例手记, 示例作者 and 订阅 RSS. Do not invent avatar/gallery/project rows/friend icons. Preserve profile vs magazine difference and configured forest-green accent.
